 Rajesh Mathur, Kathiyo Ka Chowk, Banshiwala, Temple,
 Nagaur (Raj.).
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. B.L. Choudhary For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, P.P.
 Mr. Lal Singh Rathore, for the  complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/09/2023

The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.c. has been filed by the petitioners seeking quashing of the F.I.R. No.79/2021, registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Nagaur for the offences under Sections 498A, 406, 323 and 506 IPC and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the parties have settled their disputes and have arrived at a compromise.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance on a decision of Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr. reported in (2012)10 SCC 303].
[2023:RJ-JD:30618] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-1973/2023] He therefore prayed that the impugned FIR may kindly be quashed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the complainant concurs the factum of compromise and submits that in view of the compromise, the complainant is not inclined to proceed further in the matter.

In view of compromise arrived at between the parties and applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra), this Court deems it just and proper to invoke inherent powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed.
The F.I.R. No.79/2021, registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Nagaur, for the offences under Sections 498A, 406, 323 and 506 IPC and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act
and all subsequent proceedings sought to be taken thereunder against the petitioner, are quashed.
